raw_note: Each raw file is the response body as received, named by its SHA-256. An entry is one distinct body of one page: retrieved_at is when those bytes were first received, last_seen_at the latest run that received the same bytes again.
access_note: curl with the declared User-Agent 'UAL Counterfactual Lab research', one request per second. On 2026-10-10 the same request from Python httpx was answered 403 Access Denied by the site's edge (AkamaiGHost), with the declared agent and with a browser agent; curl with the declared agent was answered 200. No browser is imitated.
revision_rule: 1. Within one page, a date listed twice with the same number is kept once; listed twice with different numbers, the page is refused. 2. When a date is listed on more than one stored page (the running-year page, a per-year page, or an earlier stored copy of either), the number from the page with the latest last_seen_at is used. 3. In one run the running-year page is requested first and the per-year pages after it, so a per-year page outranks the running-year page of the same run; an exact tie in time also goes to the per-year page. 4. Every date on which two stored pages disagree is listed under revisions with both numbers. No number is averaged, and a date no stored page lists is left out.
